GPC Title: Guideline: assessing and managing children at primary health-care facilities to prevent overweight and obesity in the context of the double burden of malnutrition
Recommendation full-text (ENG): Routinely providing supplementary foods to moderately wasted infants and children (i.e. with acute undernutrition) presenting to primary health-care facilities is not recommended
Recommendation full-text (ESP): No se recomienda administrar sistemáticamente alimentos complementarios a los lactantes y niños con emaciación moderada (es decir, con desnutrición aguda) que acudan a los establecimientos de atención primaria de salud.
Recommendation full-text (FR): Il n'est pas recommandé de fournir systématiquement des aliments complémentaires aux nourrissons et aux enfants souffrant d'émaciation modérée (c'est-à-dire de dénutrition aiguë) qui se présentent dans les centres de soins de santé primaires.
Recommendation full-text (PT): Não se recomenda o fornecimento rotineiro de alimentos suplementares a bebês e crianças com déficit ponderal moderado (ou seja, com desnutrição aguda) levados a unidades de atenção primária à saúde
Recommendation title (ENG) Epistemonikos: Guideline: assessing and managing children at primary health-care facilities to prevent overweight and obesity in the context of the double burden of malnutrition [1]

GPC Title: Guideline: assessing and managing children at primary health-care facilities to prevent overweight and obesity in the context of the double burden of malnutrition
Recommendation full-text (ENG): The provision of supplementary foods for treating stunting (chronic undernutrition) among infants and children who present to primary health-care facilities is not recommended
Recommendation full-text (ESP): No se recomienda el suministro de alimentos suplementarios para el tratamiento del retraso en el crecimiento (subalimentación crónica) a los lactantes y los niños que se presentan en los centros de atención primaria de la salud
Recommendation full-text (FR): Il n'est pas recommandé de fournir des aliments complémentaires pour traiter le retard de croissance (dénutrition chronique) chez les nourrissons et les enfants qui se présentent dans les établissements de soins de santé primaires.
Recommendation full-text (PT): Não se recomenda o fornecimento rotineiro de alimentos suplementares a bebês e crianças com déficit estatural (ou seja, com desnutrição crônica) levados a unidades de atenção primária à saúde
Recommendation title (ENG) Epistemonikos: Guideline: assessing and managing children at primary health-care facilities to prevent overweight and obesity in the context of the double burden of malnutrition [2]

GPC Title: Guideline: assessing and managing children at primary health-care facilities to prevent overweight and obesity in the context of the double burden of malnutrition
Recommendation full-text (ENG): At primary health-care facilities, children aged less than 5 years who are identified as obese should be assessed and an appropriate management plan should be developed. This can be done by a health worker at primary health-care level, if adequately trained, or at a referral clinic or local hospital
Recommendation full-text (ESP): En establecimientos de atención primaria de la salud, los niños de menores de 5 años identificados con obesidad deben evaluarse y se debe elaborar un plan apropiado para el tratamiento. Esto lo puede realizar un trabajador de la salud en el nivel de la atención primaria si está adecuadamente capacitado, o en un dispensario u hospital local al que se le haya derivado.
Recommendation full-text (FR): Dans les établissements de soins de santé primaires, les enfants âgés de moins de 5 ans qui sont identifiés comme étant obèses doivent être évalués et un plan de prise en charge approprié doit être élaboré. Cela peut être effectué par un agent de santé au niveau des soins de santé primaires, s'il a reçu une formation adéquate, ou dans une clinique de référence ou un hôpital local.
Recommendation full-text (PT): Nas unidades de atenção primária à saúde, as crianças menores de 5 anos identificadas como obesas devem ser avaliadas e deve ser desenvolvido um plano de manejo apropriado. Isso pode ficar a cargo de um profissional de saúde na própria unidade de atenção primária, se adequadamente treinado, ou em uma clínica ou hospital local de referência
Recommendation title (ENG) Epistemonikos: Guideline: assessing and managing children at primary health-care facilities to prevent overweight and obesity in the context of the double burden of malnutrition [5]
Population: Children aged less than 5 years who are identified as obese
Intervention: Be assessed and an appropriate management plan should be developed
